title: Qwen3.8-27B Q4_K_M on gfx1151: sampled MTP on INT8 KV speculates, matches its own no-MTP INT8 autoregressive baseline, and is seed-repeatable
purpose: Task 5 acceptance. The INT8 declaration states that temperature, penalty, logit_bias and suppress_token_ids requests are executed by the sampled MTP route; this records the live measurement of that statement through the HTTP surface, plus a re-run of the induced-law gate on the same revision. No speed claim is made or implied.

server.command: bash /tmp/t17-env-int8-lru.sh /home/lhl/miniforge3/envs/vllm/bin/python -m hipengine.server --model /models/gguf/Qwen3.8-27B-Q4_K_M.gguf --backend hip_gfx1151 --served-model-name int8-lru-diag-20260922 --max-context-tokens 9216 --max-active-requests 4 --kv-storage int8_per_token_head --kv-scale-dtype fp32 --execution-profile production --speculative-mtp-serving enabled --speculative-candidate-budget 3 --prefix-cache off --no-startup-chat-smoke --no-startup-scratch-probe --host 127.0.0.1 --port 18198 --info

acceptance.speculates: Every speculative arm reported used=true with a real cycle count (8-15 cycles per request); every baseline arm reported used=false, route=default, cycles=0, so the comparison is against true no-MTP autoregressive decoding.
acceptance.baseline_parity: Finish reason and the usage triple match in all 12 request pairs per run. The route-specific completion_tokens_details are reported per arm and are not compared: they carry draft accept counts that a no-MTP baseline cannot have.
acceptance.repeatability: Two runs of the whole matrix with the same seeds produced identical ids and identical cycle counts for both arms.
acceptance.induced_law: scripts/mtp_sampled_accept_distribution_gate.py re-run on the same revision: verdict pass, 824 induced-law comparisons with max total variation 4.53e-16 and max KL 9.03e-16 against a 1e-9 tolerance, 144/144 autoregressive-law agreements, and an 18-row Monte-Carlo arm with top-1 agreement 1.0.

observation.ids_match_baseline: 12 of 12 seeded requests emitted exactly the token ids their own no-MTP baseline emitted. This was not required by the acceptance and is not a proof of the distribution: it is what a shared seeded draw stream produces when the coupling is exact, and it is the strongest end-to-end signal available from a token comparison. The induced-law gate above is what proves the law.

coverage.covered: Four sampler families (temperature/top_p, penalties, logit_bias, suppress_token_ids) x three prompts x two runs, speculative against true no-MTP baseline, on the INT8 cell; the induced-law gate on the same revision.
coverage.not_covered: Finish-rule parameters (min_tokens, eos_token_id, stop ids, stop sequences) and logprobs, which are refused by the servable-blocker set and belong to tasks 6 and 7; multi-choice and tool/structured requests, which belong to task 17; throughput, which this task does not claim.

induced_law_report_note: Summary plus one representative row per prompt, as the 2026-09-18 artifact of this gate does; the omitted rows are covered by the same maxima the summary reports.
